dashboards.name: Executive Lakehouse Overview
dashboards.description: Real-time KPI metrics and visual analytics across workforce, market equity, products, and customer revenue with interactive parameters.

widgets.title: Total Workforce
widgets.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM silver_employees WHERE (:department IS NULL OR department = :department) AND (:start_date IS NULL OR :start_date = '' OR hire_date >= :start_date) AND (:end_date IS NULL OR :end_date = '' OR hire_date <= :end_date)

widgets.title: Annual Payroll
widgets.query: SELECT SUM(salary) as value FROM silver_employees WHERE (:department IS NULL OR department = :department) AND (:start_date IS NULL OR :start_date = '' OR hire_date >= :start_date) AND (:end_date IS NULL OR :end_date = '' OR hire_date <= :end_date)

widgets.title: Total Market Cap (NYSE)
widgets.query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(market_cap_b), 1) as value FROM nyse_tickers WHERE (:sector IS NULL OR sector = :sector)

widgets.title: Total Inventory Value
widgets.query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price * stock_qty), 2) as value FROM dim_products WHERE (:category IS NULL OR category = :category)

widgets.title: Average Salary by Department
widgets.query: SELECT department, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) as avg_salary FROM silver_employees WHERE (:department IS NULL OR department = :department) AND (:start_date IS NULL OR :start_date = '' OR hire_date >= :start_date) AND (:end_date IS NULL OR :end_date = '' OR hire_date <= :end_date) GROUP BY department ORDER BY avg_salary DESC

widgets.title: Market Cap Distribution by Sector
widgets.query: SELECT sector, ROUND(SUM(market_cap_b), 1) as total_mcap FROM nyse_tickers WHERE (:sector IS NULL OR sector = :sector) GROUP BY sector

widgets.title: Inventory Valuation by Category
widgets.query: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(price * stock_qty), 2) as total_val FROM dim_products WHERE (:category IS NULL OR category = :category) GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_val DESC

widgets.title: Top Enterprise & Mid-Market Accounts
widgets.query: SELECT full_name, segment, annual_spend, join_date FROM dim_customers ORDER BY annual_spend DESC LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Compensation Momentum
widgets.query: SELECT hire_date, ROUND(AVG(salary), 0) as avg_comp FROM silver_employees GROUP BY hire_date ORDER BY hire_date

widgets.title: Customer Quota Target
widgets.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(annual_spend) / 1000, 1) as quota_pct FROM dim_customers

widgets.title: Workforce Comp Trajectory
widgets.query: SELECT hire_date, ROUND(SUM(salary), 0) as total_comp FROM silver_employees GROUP BY hire_date ORDER BY hire_date

widgets.title: Market Cap Treemap
widgets.query: SELECT company, ROUND(market_cap_b, 1) as market_cap FROM nyse_tickers ORDER BY market_cap DESC LIMIT 15

widgets.title: Department Comp Radar
widgets.query: SELECT department, ROUND(AVG(salary)/1000, 1) as comp_k FROM silver_employees GROUP BY department

widgets.title: Account Segment Funnel
widgets.query: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) as accounts FROM dim_customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY accounts DESC

widgets.title: Workforce Headcount Pivot Table
widgets.query: SELECT department, rank, COUNT(*) as headcount FROM silver_employees GROUP BY department, rank ORDER BY department, rank

widgets.title: Salary vs Bonus Analysis
widgets.query: SELECT salary, bonus_estimate FROM silver_employees WHERE salary IS NOT NULL AND bonus_estimate IS NOT NULL AND (:start_date IS NULL OR :start_date = '' OR hire_date >= :start_date) AND (:end_date IS NULL OR :end_date = '' OR hire_date <= :end_date)

widgets.title: Market Cap vs P/E Ratio
widgets.query: SELECT market_cap_b, pe_ratio FROM nyse_tickers WHERE market_cap_b IS NOT NULL AND pe_ratio IS NOT NULL

widgets.title: Employee Rank vs Compensation
widgets.query: SELECT rank, salary FROM silver_employees WHERE rank IS NOT NULL AND salary IS NOT NULL

widgets.title: Department vs Rank Headcount Matrix
widgets.query: SELECT department, CAST(rank AS VARCHAR) as rank_level, COUNT(*) as headcount FROM silver_employees GROUP BY department, rank ORDER BY department, rank

widgets.title: Product Category Inventory Heatmap
widgets.query: SELECT category, CASE WHEN stock_qty < 50 THEN 'Low' WHEN stock_qty < 150 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END as stock_level, SUM(price * stock_qty) as total_value FROM dim_products GROUP BY category, stock_level ORDER BY category, stock_level

widgets.title: Customer Segment vs Spending Tier
widgets.query: SELECT segment, CASE WHEN annual_spend < 50000 THEN 'Tier 1' WHEN annual_spend < 80000 THEN 'Tier 2' ELSE 'Tier 3' END as spend_tier, COUNT(*) as customer_count FROM dim_customers GROUP BY segment, spend_tier ORDER BY segment, spend_tier
